text:
Three causes, all fixed on branch cl21-seen-state (the orchestrator republishes after the merge):

- **Welcome thread:** two orchestrator answers to your Likes (22:01 "Launched CL8, CL9 and CL10", 22:19 "CL12 launched") hung under the Like, which is never drawn. So they were never on your screen and could never be marked read. They now show in the thread.
- **cl10, and any post a session keeps touching:** a read post came back as new whenever its `updated_at` moved (status, session id), even with the same text. Now only text you have not seen, or a comment you have not seen, makes it new.
- cl10 also really changed: its text was rewritten between your 02:19 and 02:41 reads, and it answered you at 02:32. Those still count as new, once.

Tests: 13 of 13 checks, including these two cases (red on the live page). All suites pass, 8 of 8.
